Coram : M.R. SHAH*, B.V. NAGARATHNA
Constitution of India – Writ petition – Exceeding of jurisdiction by High Court – Respondent no.1-writ petitioner bought properties auctioned in pursuance of Recovery Certificate which was in favour of bank – 25% of the as earnest money – Respondent no.1 filed application seeking some clarity in the matter, replied by Bank – However, thereafter the Recovery Officer dismissed the application and forfeited 10% of the amount deposited– Appeal filed by respondent no.1, dismissed by DRT –
Decision Date : 16-02-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1302/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
